question: Which city smart city bus project has won the India Smart Cities Award (ISAC) 2020 in the Urban Mobility category.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aurangabad.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The India Smart Cities Award (ISAC) 2020 is an initiative of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) to recognize and reward cities, projects, and innovative ideas that promote sustainable development in India.**
 
• The **Urban Mobility category** of the** ISAC 2020 **recognizes cities that have implemented smart and sustainable transport solutions to enhance the **mobility **of their citizens.
 
• **The Aurangabad Smart City Development Corporation Limited (ASCDCL) won the award in this category for its smart city bus project, which aims to provide safe, comfortable, and affordable public transport services to the people of Aurangabad.**
 
• The project involves the deployment of **200 smart buses** equipped with GPS, CCTV cameras, automated fare collection systems, and real-time passenger information systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indore has been recognized as the cleanest city in India for four consecutive years (2017-2020) under the Swachh Survekshan program.**

 
 
• It has also implemented several smart city projects, such as the **Indore BRTS **(Bus Rapid Transit System) and the** Indore Smart City App**, to improve the quality of life of its citizens.
 
 
 
• **Pune is another city that has implemented several smart city projects, such as the Pune Smart City 24x7 Water Supply Project and the Pune Smart City Command and Control Center.**
 
 
• It has also been recognized as the second most livable city in India in the Ease of Living Index 2020.
 
 
 
• **Agra** is famous for its iconic monument, the **TajMahal**, and attracts millions of tourists every year.
 
 
• **It has also implemented several smart city projects, such as the Agra Smart City Integrated Command and Control Center and the Agra Smart City Public Bike Sharing System, to enhance the urban infrastructure and services in the city.**
